answer: At a comet apparition, each identity stands at its knoll ledge for ten minutes, filing a sighting: angle, key, timestamp. A ceremony bond locks 70. Auditors check each ledge and angle against the ephemeris; a copied sighting burns both. One operator cannot attend two ledges in one comet window: first 36, k-th 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500, pool 40,000. A rented-observer ring fails: one observer, one ledge; honest agents pay 36 once.
